name: A month of books of a Dar es Salaam trading company, VAT-registered and filing monthly

documents.why: A domestic sale at the standard rate of 18 %: box 1 and the output VAT of box 6.
An export of goods within the meaning of s. 2 of the Act, zero-rated under s. 55(1): box 2, no output VAT, and a matched payment later on.
An export of a service to a customer outside the United Republic who effectively uses it there, zero-rated under s. 61A: box 2, and an unmatched advance payment later on.

Locally manufactured goods supplied to a taxable person registered under the VAT law of Tanzania Zanzibar, zero-rated under s. 55A — a zero rate that is neither an ordinary export nor a domestic sale: box 2, and a matched payment later on.
An outpatient consultation, exempt under First Schedule, Part I, item 10(1): box 3, no output VAT, and a matched payment later on.
A credit note for one unit returned from INV-001, so box 1 and box 6 fall back down and a sale_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Office furniture, retail sale — one unit returned

documents.why: A domestic purchase at the standard rate, deductible in full under s. 68(1): box 7 and the input VAT of box 12, and a matched payment later on.
A passenger vehicle whose input tax is disallowed under s. 68(3): the VAT becomes part of the cost of the vehicle and reaches no box.

lines.name: Passenger motor vehicle for the sales manager

documents.why: A group life insurance premium, exempt under First Schedule, Part I, item 13: no input tax, box 8.
An import of goods: VAT collected by the Commissioner General at the border under s. 8, claimed as input tax through box 9 and held on the customs control account until settled.

A service imported from a supplier with no place of business in Mainland Tanzania: the recipient self-charges the output tax on box 5 and claims it back on box 10, netting to nothing on a wholly taxable purchase.
A purchase credit note for a short delivery on PINV-001, so box 7 and box 12 fall back down and a purchase_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Trading stock purchased for resale — short-delivery credit

payments.why: The consultation fee of INV-005 collected in full: a matched inbound payment on an exempt sale.
The Zanzibar zero-rated supply of INV-004 collected in full: a matched inbound payment.
The export of INV-002 collected in full: a matched inbound payment in a foreign trade relationship.
PINV-001 settled in full, VAT included: a matched outbound payment.
An advance received from Bristol Analytics Ltd before its next invoice, matched to nothing: reconcile() has to survive an open item.
